title: WheelStates V2.0
description: Enumerates wheel actuator states for CAV Motion Actuation.

oneOf.description: Steering actuator operating normally & following commands within expected tolerance.
Actuator holding the wheel at its current angle (e.g., hill-hold stabilisation).
Actuator actively controlling the wheel angle in response to commands.
Wheel released with minimal assistive torque applied.
Wheel cannot move as commanded; mechanical or servo obstruction.
Wheel angle reached mechanical end-stop; no further movement allowed.
Actuator temperature exceeds rated thermal limits; performance derated.
Reduced operational capability due to subsystem constraints or partial fault.
General actuator or sensor fault requiring inspection or fallback mode.
Steering actuator unavailable (offline, in maintenance, or non-responsive).
Actuator performing calibration or alignment procedures.
Actuator performing startup or periodic diagnostics.
Thermal derating active due to excessive actuator temperature.
Derating active due to high mechanical or steering rack load.
Fault detected in wheel angle, encoder, or feedback sensors.
Communication between steering controller and actuator is impaired.
Insufficient power supply to support nominal steering behavior.
Emergency logic temporarily overrides actuator control for safety.
